result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken discount badge showing '-0%', truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip row that clips labels.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which looks broken or like incorrect/placeholder data rather than a meaningful offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero, or display a valid percentage/promo text.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the card title in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure cards give enough width so names are fully readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right with no label, which looks unfinished next to 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chips are fully formed when partially scrolled into view, or add proper spacing/peek styling so incomplete empty chips are not shown.
